props.title: Millcreek Terrain and Slope in 3D
props.snippet: Slope in six classes and 2 m contours draped on Millcreek's 0.5 m lidar terrain, from the valley floor to the east bench. Unvalidated planning estimates; not surveyed or field-verified.
props.description:
Planning estimates. Everything here comes from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023) and the City of Millcreek's processing of it. These are unvalidated planning estimates, not surveyed or field-verified data. Do not use them for engineering, legal or property decisions.

Slope in six classes and 2 m contours draped on Millcreek's 0.5 m lidar terrain, from the valley floor to the east bench. Use the slides for the hillside neighbourhoods, or drag to look around.

Built on the web scene 71b680b486b245fd8ec17eb80387be94; each layer's own page describes how it was made, its fields and its limits.

Questions or corrections: City of Millcreek GIS.
props.accessInformation: City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP)
